title: Original voltage monotonicity gives a linear-capacity transport inequality
statement: Attractive heatbath, decreasing A and a shared rate-kappa source clock make original v decreasing. Every upward native current is nonnegative and its sum across any one coordinate cut is<=C, including source-target overlap. A path/flow load with coordinate congestion a_i gives occupation<=C*sum a_i. Monotone native paths suffice; for general signed flows the correction permits discarding negative terms and bounding positive congestion. An XOR mean-MGF estimate alone is not that pointwise bound.
